## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `857e696253024f3894f7a6fc4f1543b090948ce6`
Local-runs: probe — `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 857e696` (object store only, no checkout, no build, no test) to read what the head becomes once it carries #26937, which merged before this PR was opened
Scope: packages/formula/src/template-engine.ts, packages/formula/src/mail-hole-grammar.ts, packages/formula/src/template-unknown-formatter.test.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-email-template-hole-grammar.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-email-template-hole-grammar.unknown-formatter.test.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.email-template-unknown-formatter.test.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-engine.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-engine.test.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-unknown-formatter.render.test.ts, packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts + packages/spec/src/system/email-template.zod.ts, content/docs/references/system/email-template.mdx, packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/templates/auth-templates.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/text-field-html-outlets.pin.test.ts, packages/formula/src/mail-html-hole-placement.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/email-channel.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/inbox-channel.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-email-sms-delivery.ts, skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md, docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md, scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs

Inputs read: card #26948 (body, triage 6455660116, claim 6465542682, dev report 6467173175), PR #27217 body and file list, the net diff `72629f38..857e696`, the check-runs on the head (none exist: `total_count 0`, combined status `pending`, 0 workflow runs), PR #26937 and its file list, `origin/main` at `9dacccf9`.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`judgeHoleFormatter` gains `known-formatter`** (`packages/formula/src/template-engine.ts`): a formatter name that is a single `\w+` word and not in `TEMPLATE_FORMATTERS` is refused, after `one-formatter`, before the `currency` argument. **Right.** The whitelist is `Object.keys(FORMATTERS)` (own enumerable keys) and the check is `Array.prototype.includes`, so `constructor`, `__proto__`, `hasOwnProperty`, `toString`, `valueOf` are refused and nothing is looked up on the object. There is no second whitelist check anywhere: the lint rule, the publish door and the placement judge all read `parseMailHole`.
2. **The mail grammar carries it with no code change** (`mail-hole-grammar.ts`): `parseMailHole` already calls `judgeHoleFormatter`, so `{{ due | dat:long }}`, `{{ due | Date }}` and `{{{ link | lowr }}}` are now holes with a refusal, located by `judgeMailHoleGrammar`. **Right.** The accept set of `email-template-hole-grammar`, `os validate` / `build` / `lint` and the `email_template` runtime gate narrows by exactly that set; the door answers `422 INVALID_METADATA` with the rule, the path and the known list (pinned in the metadata-protocol test).
3. **The mail renderer** (`plugin-email/src/template-engine.ts`): the refusal throws `TEMPLATE_INVALID` before `formatValue` runs; the raw fallback is gone; a second guard throws if `formatValue` ever answers `undefined`. **Right.** `EmailService` prefixes `email template NAME (locale=L)` (unchanged wrap at `email-service.ts:1465`). The inherited keys never reach `formatValue`'s `FORMATTERS[name]` lookup because the grammar refuses them first.
4. **Send paths, read on `origin/main`.** `sendTemplate` throws; `service-messaging` `email-channel.ts:425` and `inbox-channel.ts:254` both grade `TEMPLATE_INVALID` `permanent`, so a delivery row dead-letters on attempt one with the code on the row — one row per recipient, so a bulk or scheduled send loses only the rows of the broken template, and the refusal is on each row, not swallowed. The notify node (`notify-node.ts:1147-1166`) enqueues through `messaging.emit` and reports `enqueued`; the refusal surfaces on the delivery rows, not on the flow run, exactly as the `TEMPLATE_INVALID` refusals of #26799 and #26937 do today. `plugin-auth`'s notices are best-effort (`auth-manager-email-sms-delivery.ts:217`, logged, never rethrown) and the built-in auth templates use only `datetime:long`. **Right: no send path that degrades gracefully today is turned into a dropped batch; the one thing that changes is that a raw value is no longer delivered.**
5. **In-app side effect** (`templateEngine.compile`): `{{ x | toString }}` used to pass `!FORMATTERS[name]` and print `[object Object]`; `{{ x | __proto__ }}` used to throw a TypeError out of `evaluate` rather than return an `EvalResult`. Both are now a compile refusal with the shared sentence, so flow text slots, action copy, `confirmText`, `titleFormat` and `promptTemplate` narrow by the inherited keys too. **Right, and a hardening.** An unknown word name keeps the dialect's own sentence (pinned).
6. **`TemplateHoleGrammarRule` gains one member.** On the head's base that is the only public type change; on `main` the union already has four members (#26937), so the merged union is five. **Right once merged** (see ④ M1).
7. **Not narrowed, by design:** text after `|` that is not one word (`{{ x | two words }}`, `{{ x | date-long }}`, `{{ x | currency :EUR }}`) is still no hole in the mail grammar and is printed verbatim, pinned by `text-field-html-outlets.pin.test.ts:284`; the in-app dialect refuses the same text. The PR leaves this as it was. **Right as a boundary of this card, see ④ S1.**
8. **Census, re-run on `origin/main` `9dacccf9`** (`git grep` over examples, apps, platform-objects, qa fixtures, skills, plugin-email templates, excluding tests and pins): the only mail holes with a formatter are eight `datetime:long` in `plugin-email/src/templates/auth-templates.ts` and one `datetime` in an `email-service.ts` comment; in-app holes in `examples/app-showcase` use `default:'…'`; skills teach `date:long` and `currency:@currency_code`. The upgrade-harness SQL fixtures carry no piped hole. **Examples 0, seeds 0, skills 0, apps 0, platform-objects 0, plugin defaults 0 — the dev's census holds.**

### ② Semver level

- `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/plugin-email`: **`minor`**, BREAKING banner, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, one `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker each. AGENTS.md §3: a kind takes at least `minor` on a package the diff moves; `(narrowing)` is BREAKING. **Matches the diff.** Plugin-email's `narrowed` is read as the render half of the one accept-set narrowing (a stored template is authored metadata judged at its next publish; until then the renderer refuses it), which is how `authoring-rules.ts` already describes the door.
- `@objectstack/spec`: **`patch`**, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` — TSDoc on `IEmailService.sendTemplate` / `renderTemplate` only. **Matches** on the head's base. After the merge it must also carry the `MAIL_TEMPLATE_HOLES` describe change (④ M1 e); that is still describe-only, so the level and both lines stay.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: a test file only; its published `files` are `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`. **No changeset is right.**
- The PR body's `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` **match** the changesets and the diff.
- ADR-0087: the category's one mechanical check is that the body carries no FROM→TO prescription; none of the three bodies does (the "remedy" names a correction a human makes, it prescribes no rewrite). A conversion cannot know which formatter was meant, so no D2 entry; nothing stored changes shape, so no D3 migration; the D1 half — a machine-readable refusal at the door naming the rule and the remedy — is delivered and pinned. **Disposition right.** ⚠ The gate itself (`check-adr-0087-registration`) has not run on this head: see ④ M1.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev `open_questions` A/B** (the spec's `MAIL_TEMPLATE_HOLES` sentence once #26937 is in): **A.** `packages/spec/src/system/email-template.zod.ts` on `main` describes the three faces with "at most one formatter per hole (a second, chained formatter is refused)" and its comment says "It promises no refusal of an unknown formatter name: none exists today (… #26948)". The moment this lands that comment is false and the description under-states the grammar a published rule enforces; it is the same change, so it goes in at the merge with `gen:schema && gen:docs` (the sentence is regenerated into `content/docs/references/system/email-template.mdx:52-54`) and a line in the spec changeset. Not a follow-up.
- **Dev `out_of_scope_findings`** (non-word formatter text left verbatim in mail, refused in-app): the dev noted it and filed nothing. It needs a card — ④ S1.
- **Dev flag "only textual overlap with #26937 is the `TemplateHoleGrammarRule` line":** true as a textual conflict and false as a merge: the merge also has to keep the `dialect` parameter, put the rule in the right place, carry the spec sentence and the lint roster comment — ④ M1 lists it.
- **`Skills-docs: none`:** verified. `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md:444` teaches "the formatter whitelist is `TEMPLATE_FORMATTERS`, exported from `@objectstack/formula`", and no skill writes a mail hole outside it (`objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:111` uses `date:long`; formula SKILL.md:450 uses `currency:@currency_code`). Right.
- **Dev flag "ablation: the `sendTemplate` case stayed green through the renderer's own guard":** read as stated; the three face cases assert the grammar's sentence and went red, so the rule is measured. No escalation.
- **Triage "same family as #26939, one PR may carry both":** #26939 is open and unclaimed by a PR; this PR carries only #26948. Fine.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing, read against the published spec on `main`: the spec's `email_template` faces describe a hole as `{{ path | formatter[:arg] }}` over a whitelist the formula skill names, `IEmailService` already declares `TEMPLATE_INVALID` for a hole the authoring rules refuse, and the in-app dialect refuses an unknown name. The PR takes no declared capability away at the consumer: no document ever promised that an unknown name renders the raw value; it makes the spec's own refusal real on the one dialect where it was missing. The design holds; the head does not.

**M1 — must-fix: the head is not landable and no gate has judged it.** #26937 merged into `main` as `22058635` at 09:58Z; this PR was opened at 10:56Z from `72629f38`, the pre-#26937 base, and never merged `main`. GitHub reports `mergeable_state: dirty`; `git merge-tree` confirms a content conflict in `packages/formula/src/template-engine.ts` over the `TemplateHoleGrammarRule` union. Because the merge ref does not exist, **zero check-runs and zero workflow runs exist on `857e696`** — there is no gate verdict for this record to adopt, and the PR body's local results are the dev's own account, which this review does not take as the gates'. The head must merge `main`, and the merge must do all of this (verified by reading the merge-tree result `9f721ee8`):
  - (a) `TemplateHoleGrammarRule` becomes the five-member union: `one-formatter`, `known-formatter`, `currency-code-literal`, `currency-code-path-mail-only`, `currency-code-path-undeclared`; `CURRENCY_ARGUMENT_RULE` stays beside it.
  - (b) `judgeHoleFormatter` keeps the fifth `dialect` parameter from #26937; the `known-formatter` branch sits after the `one-formatter` branch and before the `formatter === 'currency'` block (git places it there, but the file is unusable until the union hunk is resolved); `WORD_RE` stays.
  - (c) `plugin-email/src/template-engine.ts` auto-merges correctly — `codePath` resolution, then `formatValue(parsed.formatter, raw, arg, …)`, then the `formatted === undefined` throw — keep it as merged; `mail-hole-grammar.ts` and the lint rule header auto-merge clean.
  - (d) The formula test calls `judgeHoleFormatter` with four arguments; it stays valid since `dialect` defaults to `in-app`. #26937's `template-currency-code-path.test.ts` pins the spec description against `CURRENCY_ARGUMENT_RULE`, so the clause added in (e) must leave that sentence intact.
  - (e) `MAIL_TEMPLATE_HOLES` and its comment in `packages/spec/src/system/email-template.zod.ts` gain the unknown-formatter refusal (③ A), `gen:schema && gen:docs`, and the spec changeset says so.
  - (f) The `validateEmailTemplateHoleGrammar` roster comment in `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` (around line 2470-2482, the text #26937's S1 reworded) enumerates the refusals; add the unknown-formatter clause.
  - (g) Then CI runs on the merged head: every derived family, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check:generated`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, and the dogfood battery the `(narrowing)` arm owes. This record adopts no conclusion until they exist.

**S1 — should-fix: file the non-word-formatter card.** `{{ x | date-long }}` or `{{ x | currency :EUR }}` fails `FILTER_RE`, fails `WORD_RE`, and `parseMailHole` answers `null`, so every door accepts it and the renderer prints the hole's text to the recipient, while the in-app dialect refuses it as an invalid hole. The card's sentence ("a formatter not in `TEMPLATE_FORMATTERS`") reaches it; the PR's Acceptance notes draw the boundary at word names, and the verbatim behaviour is pinned (`text-field-html-outlets.pin.test.ts:284`), so it is its own narrowing. The dev wrote "noted, not filed": file it, and name it in the PR body as the follow-up.

Nothing else found. Probes that held: prototype keys at every door (①1); the rule order against `currency:@path` (a misspelled `curency:@code` is refused as `known-formatter`, a correct `currency:@code` passes to #26937's rules); a chained unknown name is refused as `one-formatter` first; `renderTemplate` / `renderPlainTextTemplate` handed a body directly throw the same `TEMPLATE_INVALID`; the placement judge reads refused holes as holes, unchanged.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-j1jtvb`
Reviewed-by: `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh`

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-1.mdx`  _(via IEmailService (symbol, a top-level interface))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/formula/src/mail-hole-grammar.ts`, `packages/lint/src/validate-email-template-hole-grammar.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **56** of **208** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **150** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ae16687ad430f4f9870ea5ba2bc9b63d6f41fc31` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `0d27374fe2a76e7c47b4de2e52ad458dbea96aca` — the merge of head `97613711a5d206bb091499645224c9c1aced6d14` into base `ae16687ad430f4f9870ea5ba2bc9b63d6f41fc31`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 0d27374fe2a76e7c47b4de2e52ad458dbea96aca && git checkout 0d27374fe2a76e7c47b4de2e52ad458dbea96aca
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin ae16687ad430f4f9870ea5ba2bc9b63d6f41fc31 97613711a5d206bb091499645224c9c1aced6d14 && git checkout -B drift-repro ae16687ad430f4f9870ea5ba2bc9b63d6f41fc31 && git merge --no-ff 97613711a5d206bb091499645224c9c1aced6d14

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ae16687ad430f4f9870ea5ba2bc9b63d6f41fc31
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs ae16687ad430f4f9870ea5ba2bc9b63d6f41fc31` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · session `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh` · 2026-10-28T12:25Z

Head `97613711a5d206bb091499645224c9c1aced6d14`. Card #26948.

- **Contract review:** `6467428438` at `857e6962` was a FAIL on one must-fix (M1): #26937 had merged, the PR was dirty, and no CI had run. The design was judged right. The must-fix named exactly what the merge had to produce, so the seat measured each item on this head instead of re-briefing a reviewer:
  - (a) `TemplateHoleGrammarRule` has the five members `one-formatter`, `known-formatter`, `currency-code-literal`, `currency-code-path-mail-only` and `currency-code-path-undeclared`, and `CURRENCY_ARGUMENT_RULE` is kept.
  - (b) `judgeHoleFormatter` keeps the `dialect` parameter, with `known-formatter` (:324) after `one-formatter` (:314) and before the currency block (:333).
  - (c, d) The plugin-email renderer and #26937's spec-description pin come through the merge.
  - (e) `MAIL_TEMPLATE_HOLES` and its comment carry the unknown-formatter clause; the spec changeset is widened, and `email-template.mdx` is regenerated.
  - (f) The `authoring-rules.ts` roster comment names `known-formatter` (:2479).
  - (g) CI ran.
  - The net diff against the merge-base is 18 files, +423/−22, all inside the card's surface.
- **Should-fix S1** (non-word formatter text printed verbatim by mail) is filed as #27225 and named in the PR body as the residual. The seat rewrote the body's serial paragraph to describe the merge as done.
- **Dev readings on this head:** a full build first. Then spec, formula, plugin-email, lint, metadata-protocol and service-messaging tests all green, and `check:generated` 14/14. Derived gates: 106 run, all exit 0, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Dogfood: 348 files and 2804 tests passed, 0 failed.
- **Gates:** check-runs on this head are 40 success, 9 skipped and 0 red. Test Core 5/8 failed once in `create-objectstack`, which is outside the diff and green locally (301 tests), and passed on the one allowed rerun. The same shard and package flaked on #27219's earlier head. `mergeable_state` is clean.
- **Landing:** `check-governed-merges --pr 27217`: NOT governed, 445 changed lines. Tier S. `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` in this act.
